Market today: July ended rough, with the momentum trade getting hammered. This is the kind of action that hits your concentrated tech/chip book hard, especially on margin.
Your holdings: SOXL is down a brutal -54.92%, and SPAL is off -60.95%. Both are leveraged ETFs and need serious attention. QQQI (-5.97%) and QQQ (-3.73%) are also in the red, with SMH (-15.06%) needing a trim.
Watch: Keep an eye on how the market digests the July selloff and if any tech names show resilience.
Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are bleeding; focus on managing that risk first.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given the -54.92% loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is down -60.95% and needs immediate risk management.
No new buys today - hold and watch
